title: Release workflow with npm trusted publishing
goal: A v* tag publishes from GitHub Actions without a token
acceptance: .github/workflows/release.yml: on tag v* from main, npm ci, the full checks, build, `npm publish --provenance --access public` from dist/bricks
permissions id-token: write; no NPM_TOKEN; Node and npm versions that support trusted publishing
The tag must match projects/bricks/package.json version
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no consuming project's real data, secrets or tokens in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Planned 2026-11-25 in the upfront step plan: scoped to one PR, at most 1 focused day(s). Not a measurement.
